# snail

Reusable agent skills and an optional stage-gated workflow.

## Entry points

- README.md — overview and quick start
- AGENTS.md — agent index and workflow notes
- package.json — package manager (nub), scripts, and dependencies

## Skills

- skills/snail-ai-toolbelt/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-alternatives/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-explore/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-flow/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-implement/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-planning/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-planning/templates/masterplan.yaml
- skills/snail-planning/templates/plan.yaml
- skills/snail-pr/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-project-docs/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-review-alternatives/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-review-plan/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-review/SKILL.md
- skills/snail-verify/SKILL.md

## Rules

- rules/no-comments.md
- rules/snail.md

## Scripts

All scripts are Node (24+); the YAML parser is vendored inside each skill that needs it.

- skills/snail-flow/scripts/flow-state.mjs — the runbook gate (init/check/advance/note/set)
- skills/snail-implement/scripts/run-with-receipt.mjs + check-receipt.mjs — check receipts
- skills/snail-planning/scripts/lint-plan.mjs — plan structure lint
- scripts/install.mjs — install the Cursor plugin
- scripts/install-claude-rules.mjs — install rules into ~/.claude
- scripts/sync-devin-plugin.mjs — sync skills/rules into plugins/snail
- scripts/gen-skills-index.mjs — regenerate the skill list in rules/snail.md
- scripts/vendor-js-yaml.mjs — refresh vendored js-yaml copies

## Tests

- tests/ — node --test suite (npm test)
